The purest magical energy to fill the Holy Grail.
The ‘greatest souls of humanity’, the guardians, are what they sought. The seven Servants are sacrifices they prepared.”

“——Wha—”

Saber looks up at the man in horror.

Her eyes struggle desperately to deny him.

…It cannot be true.

She seems to insist to herself that the Holy Grail she pursued could never be something so twisted.

“
What?”
Saber looks up at the man in astonishment.
Her eyes are desperately trying to deny his words.
…That it isn’t possible.
She is trying to deny it saying that what she wished for, the Holy Grail, cannot be such a thing.

pages.en:
“There is no cause for surprise. The Holy Grail is a filter that reduces the soul—a power no one but its owner could control—to pure magical energy.

“Yes, that would certainly grant wishes. To a mage, it would represent a reserve of power that could never be exhausted.

“Thus, the more sacrifices, the better. Feed it six Servants and it might justly be called omnipotent.

“The Grail has drawn in five Servants. One more will suffice to complete the omnipotent cauldron they sought.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You should not be surprised. The Holy Grail is a filtration device that turns the soul into pure magical energy.
Yes, it should let you grant any wish. It contains more magical energy than a magus could ever use within his lifetime.
That is why it is better with more sacrifices. It should be omnipotent with six Servants as sacrifices.
Five Servants have filled the Holy Grail. Only one more is needed for the omnipotent grail they sought.”

”

“Every wish can be granted? Fool. No miracle of that order will be bestowed upon mere humans. However great the power they acquire, human beings use it only to destroy themselves.

“But—be at ease, Saber.

“This Holy Grail is genuine. Incorporate all seven Heroic Spirits, and it will unfailingly reach the Origin.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It will grant him any wish?
You idiot. Such miracles are not given to mere humans. Humans only destroy themselves, no matter how much power they are given.
But
do not worry, Saber.
This Holy Grail is real. If you insert seven Servants in it, it will reach the origin.”

pages.ja: 「……原初……？ ちょっと待った。じゃあ聖杯って、まさか」

pages.mirrorMoon: “……Origin……? Hold on. Then could the Holy Grail be…?”

“I do not know who it was, but the one who made this rule is a genius.
But it does not concern me. I have no interest in such a thing. All I am interested in is the Holy Grail’s ability to serve as the ‘gate’.”

“What—the Holy Grail is a gate…?”

“Ten years ago, Saber, when the Holy Grail was almost mine, you obstructed me.

?”

It happened ten years ago. You opposed me right when I was about to obtain the Holy Grail.
The Holy Grail was cut by the holy sword and what poured out burned the town. As I was right underneath the Holy Grail, I was showered with it.”

pages.en:
“That was when I learned the Grail's true nature.

“—It is profoundly worthless. Worthless, but not without utility.

“Among all weapons, few could be more perfectly specialized for murder. It may remain exactly as it is. There is no need to transform it into an omnipotent cauldron.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I understood the true identity of the Holy Grail at that time.
It is worthless. It is worthless, but it does have its uses.
Not many weapons are as specialized in murder as that. The Holy Grail is fine as is. There is no need to turn it into an omnipotent vessel.”

“The Holy Grail bears one name: Angra Mainyu, all the evil in this world.

Kotomine did not tell you about it?
The Holy Grail is named ‘Angra Mainyu’, or ‘all evils of the world’.
It is mud that will consume every human being, like the name states.”

pages.en:
…Angra Mainyu?

If I remember correctly, that is the name of the lord of demons in Zoroastrianism.

The ruler of evil who opposed God and continued the struggle for thousands of years.

Said to embody all the malice of humanity, it is depicted as the mirror image of all human goodness.

—But why would the Holy Grail bear the name of a demon from ancient Persia?
pages.mirrorMoon:
……Angra Mainyu?
I think that’s the name of the devil in Zoroastrianism.
The leader of evil that opposes God for many thousands of years.
It is an embodiment of the evil in all human, and it is depicted as a reflected image of all humanity’s good will.
But why is the Holy Grail named after the ancient Persian devil?

pages.en:
“Yes. To sweep humanity away. I have no intention of laboring, as Kotomine did, to cherish it. Only beautiful things deserve affection.

“This world amuses me, but it is no less intolerable.

“For common mongrels to enjoy their lives is an affront to their king.

“It leaves me with no desire to rule them.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes, to sweep the humans away. I have no intention of admiring humanity like Kotomine. I only admire beautiful things.
This world is enjoyable, but it is incorrigible at the same time.
It is an insult to the king for so many mongrels to be enjoying life.
I do not want to rule over such a world.”

pages.mirrorMoon:

“If they perish, so be it. If their own sins erase them, they possessed no worth as living things.

“I have no need of mongrels. Only those capable of surviving even hell possess the value to be ruled.

“In that respect, the last attempt was a failure. For them to perish in so meager a fire—the humans of this age are far too weak.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I do not care if they die out. There is no point to their lives if they end them through their own crimes.
I do not want mongrels. The only ones worth ruling over are those that can survive even the flames of hell.
In that respect, they were an utter failure ten years ago. If such a pitiful blaze will wipe them out, humans truly have become weak.”

His mouth curls upward.

For the first time,

he looks at me—the failure of whom he spoke.

He grins.
For the first time…
He looks at me, who he said is a failure.

人より生まれた、人だけを殺す底なしの闇。
本来我がすべき仕事を任せるには相応しい猟犬だ」

“I do not know what this so-called All the World's Evil truly is.

“But it is convenient, is it not? The sentence of death descending equally upon every human being.

“A bottomless darkness born of man, capable of killing man alone.

“A fitting hound to which I may entrust the labor that should rightly be mine.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I do not know what this ‘all evils of the world’ is.
But it is convenient. It is a reaper that strikes down all humans equally.
An endless darkness that is born from humans and kills them.
It is an appropriate hound to entrust with the work I should be doing.”

“Though it appears an even baser counterfeit—true scum—has found its way in…!”

it seems a worse faker is here…!”
